unit.why: A halakhic-polemical discussion of when the sanctification of the moon may be recited and of the sin of quarrelsomeness. It cites sources (Nahalat Ḥ, Responsa Heshiv Moshe, the Nesukhoyz rebbe). The brief references to deeds by the Apta rebbe and the Seer of Lublin, who once said the blessing from the Gemara, serve only as halakhic precedents inside the argument and are not narrated as a story.
unit.boundary_note: division continues the numbered series (ד) under the heading 'מענין קידוש לבנה'; the closing heading 'מענין קנאה' belongs to the next division (ה)
